newsitem.title: CROATIA: SOCCER-CROATIA ZAGREB BUY BACK PROSINECKI FROM SEVILLA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CROATIA ZAGREB BUY BACK PROSINECKI FROM SEVILLA.

text.p: Croatia's Robert Prosinecki, formerly with Sevilla, has returned to rejoin Croatia Zagreb, club officials confirmed on Tuesday.
Prosinecki has signed a one-year contract with his original club, previously named Dinamo, after 10 years abroad. Apart from Sevilla, he played in Spain for Real Madrid, Oviedo and Barcelona.
Some 2,000 fans gathered to greet him at Croatia's Maksimir stadium where the signing took place on Monday.
"I have come home and I am pleased to be back," Prosinecki said.
